evidence.title: 〔東京外為〕ドル、160円台前半＝介入で大幅下落（31日午後5時）
evidence.body: [e003:f01] 午後5時現在は、160円20～21銭と前日（午後5時、163円72～73銭）比3円52銭の大幅ドル安・円高。 [e003:f02] 午前は、輸入企業のドル買い・円売りなどでじり高となり、160円70銭台に上昇した。 [e003:f03] 正午に向けては伸び悩み、160円40～50銭台で推移した。 [e003:f04] 午後は、買い戻しなどで、160円50～80銭程度へ水準を切り上げた。 [e003:f05] 日銀の植田和男総裁が会見で「これまで以上に物価上振れリスクを意識する必要がある」と述べると、159円90銭台に下落。 [e003:f06] その後は下げ止まり、160円20～60銭台で推移した。 [e003:f07] 30日の米国市場では、政府・日銀が円安進行を阻止するために、円買い・ドル売り介入を実施。 [e003:f08] ドル円は157円台後半と10月中旬以来、約2カ月半ぶりの安値水準を付けた。 [e003:f09] 31日の東京市場は、買い戻しが強まり一時160円台後半に上昇し、介入効果は半減した。 [e003:f10] （了） 時事通信 関連ニュース 〔NY金〕上伸、4160.60ドル（30日） 〔欧州株式〕おおむね上昇＝英0.10％安、独0.60％高（30日） 〔ロンドン金〕3日ぶり反発＝4085.34ドル（30日） 〔NY外為〕円急騰、一時157円台＝円買い介入観測も浮上（30日午前11時） 〔香港外為〕ドル、午後3時現在160円25～31銭（31日） 最終更新: 7/31(金) 17:34 時事通信 最近見た銘柄 ヘッドライン もっと見る マーケット指標 世界の指数 FX・為替情報 日本株ランキング アプリ 経済ニュースや為替・株価アプリの決定版 Facebook 選りすぐりの投資・マネー情報をお届け VIP倶楽部 データのダウンロードほかVIP専用の情報を入手 Yahoo! evidence.body: [e005:f01] 【日本株週間展望】値固め、堅調な企業決算やAI投資への懸念後退 7/31(金) 15:41 配信 （ブルームバーグ）： 8月第1週（3－7日）の日本株は、国内企業の堅調な決算やAI投資の収益性懸念の緩和を背景に値固めの展開が予想される。 [e005:f02] このところの相場の乱高下で痛手を受けた市場参加者も多いとみられ、不安定な値動きが続く可能性もある。 [e005:f03] 7月最終週の日本株市場では、米IT企業による巨額のAI関連先行投資が期待ほどの収益を生まないのではないかとの懸念から日経平均株価が一時約2カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。 [e005:f04] その後、マイクロソフトやアマゾン・ドット・コムなど米ハイパースケーラー（大規模クラウド事業者）の決算が良好だったことなどから反発した。 [e005:f05] 日経平均は週間ベースで0.4%安、東証株価指数（TOPIX）は0.2%安だった。 [e005:f06] 7月の市場を揺るがしたAI設備投資を巡る懸念は和らぎつつあり、株価は再び上昇余地を探るとみる市場関係者は多い。 [e005:f07] ただ、半導体株を中心に変動率が極めて高い相場が続いており、当面は不安定な値動きに注意が必要との声も聞かれる。 [e005:f08] 8月第1週は国内でTOPIX100を構成する大企業の約半数が決算を発表する予定で、個別株の材料により相場が動きやすくなりそうだ。 [e005:f09] 米国では半導体大手アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（AMD）などの決算のほか、供給管理協会（ISM）の景況指数や雇用関連指標の公表もあり、インフレ警戒を強める内容となれば金利上昇を通じて株価の重しになる可能性もある。 [e005:f10] ＜市場関係者の見方＞ UBS SuMi TRUSTウェルス・マネジメントの小林千紗日本株ストラテジスト 日米で決算発表がピークを迎えるが、全体的にはハイパースケーラーの決算やシタデルによるヘッジファンドの事実上の救済を受けて市場心理が改善しており、AI関連銘柄を中心としたハイベータ株主導で戻りを試しそうだ。 [e005:f11] すべてのAI関連銘柄が買われるというよりは選別が進むだろう。 [e005:f12] 銀行株は今後の日本銀行の利上げへの思惑から上昇する可能性が高いとみている。 [e005:f13] 前へ 1 2 次へ 1 / 2ページ 【関連記事】 「動物園大国」日本、人気の陰で広がる世界とのギャップ ギネス飲むなら2分待て－待ち時間を価値に変えた267年ビールブランドの逆転戦略 フェラーリ、高価格帯スポーツカー需要旺盛－業績見通し引き上げ テスラが中国事業分離検討とWSJ－マスク氏は否定 日本を「強く豊か」にする高市ビジョンが正念場、ハネムーン期間終了。

evidence.title: FX/為替「ドル/円今日の見通し｜円買い介入観測の中、日銀金融政策決定会合」 外為どっとコム トゥデイ 2026年7月31日号
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 昨日のドル/円は終値ベースで約2.4％下落。 [e006:f02] アジア時間は中東情勢の再緊迫化を背景に163円台で底堅く推移したが、欧米時間に入ると、ロンドン市場で1円あまり、NY市場で5円近く急落し5月中旬以来の157.94円前後を付けた。 [e006:f03] その後、160円近くまで戻す場面も見られたが、再び158円台半ばへ急落した。 [e006:f04] 日本政府・日銀が円買い・ドル売りの為替介入を実施し、NY連銀がレートチェックを行ったとの観測が広がった。 [e006:f05] なお、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が重視するインフレ指標である、米6月個人消費支出物価指数（PCEデフレーター）は市場予想通り前年比+3.7％と前月から伸びが鈍化した。 [e006:f06] 本日は日銀が金融政策決定会合後に政策金利を発表する。 [e006:f07] 前回会合で25bp（0.25％ポイント）の利上げを実施したこともあり、今回は政策金利は1.00％に据え置かれることが確実視されている。 [e006:f08] そのため、焦点は政策金利と同時に公表される展望レポートと、その後の植田日銀総裁の記者会見となる。 [e006:f09] 物価見通しや景気見通しに変化があるか、追加利上げに前向きな姿勢を維持できるかがポイントとなろう。 [e006:f10] 市場がタカ派的な内容と受け止めれば円買い圧力がかかる一方、慎重な姿勢が示されれば円売り圧力が強まることになる。 [e006:f11] もっとも、昨日160円手前で再び急落したことを考えると、160円台に乗せれば追加の円買い介入の可能性も排除できないため、不安定な値動きとなりそうだ。

[e004:f06] "Uncertainty and volatility are a feature and not a bug," Joseph Brusuelas, global economist at RSM, said in a note to investors about Warsh's stated preference that investors respond to economic events rather than Fed policy statements. evidence.title: What a divided Fed means for investors
evidence.body: [e006:f01] The Fed opted to [hold interest rates steady](https:// at the second meeting led by Chairman [Kevin Warsh](https:// But between his commentary about inflation and the dissenting coalition of policymakers, investors are growing increasingly confident that the Fed's next move will be an increase. [e006:f02] While the hold was widely expected by markets, three policymakers broke with the committee's decision to instead call for higher rates at this week's meeting. [e006:f03] That marked the highest number of members pushing for an increase since September 2016, according to Ian Lygen, head of U.S. rates strategy at BMO Capital Markets. [e006:f04] Back in 2016, the Fed went on to keep rates unchanged at its next meeting in November with two dissenters. [e006:f05] But by December of that year, the committee unanimously voted on a 25-basis-point increase. [e006:f06] Fed funds futures trading now suggests a more than 57% likelihood of a quarter-point increase at the September meeting, according to CME's [FedWatch](https:// tool. [e006:f07] About 53% of [Kalshi traders](https:// predict that the Fed will hike rates, compared with 43% betting on another hold. [e006:f08] "September remains a live meeting." Stephen Douglass, chief economist at NISA Investment Advisors, said the three members' dissentions could signal the Fed landed on a "hawkish hold." Still, Douglass said he still expected the Fed's next move to be a cut in March of next year. [e006:f09] Warsh said the Fed was focused on [getting inflation down](https:// to its preferred annual rate of 2% after years of hotter readings. [e006:f10] The problem: Getting there likely means policy tightening, according to DoubleLine Capital CEO [Jeffrey Gundlach](https:// "If you really want to get to 2%, I think you have to raise interest rates," Gundlach [said Wednesday](https:// on CNBC's "Closing Bell." ## [](http:// response In the meantime, unease about a future with potentially tighter monetary policy helped put investors in a risk-off mood on Wednesday. [e006:f11] The [S&P 500](https:// tumbled 1.5% in Wednesday's session, marking the worst second "Fed day" for a new chief in recent history, according to Bespoke Investment Group. [e006:f12] The blue-chip [Dow Jones Industrial Average](https:// dropped more than 2% on Wednesday, its [largest daily decline](https:// since President Donald Trump's tariff policy hampered markets in April 2025. [e006:f13] [Image 1: hide content](https:// S&P 500, 1 -day "Financial markets are still wrestling with the shift in Fed leadership," said Josh Jamner, senior investment strategy analyst at ClearBridge Investments. [e006:f14] He described increased price volatility under a Warsh-led Fed as "more of a feature than a bug." The [30-year Treasury](https:// yield climbed more than 10 basis points on Wednesday to reach its highest level [since July 2007](https:// The benchmark [10-year Treasury](https:// yield rose above the key 4.6% level, while shorter-dated yields pulled back as the meeting showed that the Fed appeared willing to wait to respond to inflation. ! [e006:f15] 30-year Treasury Fixed income investors like Gundlach said that these moves are showing the Fed that they must return to hiking to achieve their goals on inflation. evidence.title: Canada | IRCC updates guidance for C20 reciprocal employment work permits
evidence.body: [e007:f01] Key takeaways: On July 29, 2026, IRCC clarified the following guidance for the C20 reciprocal employment category: Foreign national applicants must be currently employed by a company abroad to demonstrate reciprocity. [e007:f02] Reciprocity is not tied to the applicant’s country of residence or nationality. [e007:f03] Instead, multinational companies can demonstrate reciprocity as long as they create or maintain similar opportunities for Canadian citizens or permanent residents in any of the company’s operations globally. [e007:f04] The updated guidance applies to new applications and renewals. [e007:f05] Eligible applicants may still renew C20 work permit renewals within Canada if they meet the eligibility requirements. evidence.title: S&P Acquires Majority Stake in Agusto & Co. to Deepen African Presence
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The transaction, announced in a joint statement yesterday, will bring together S&P Global Ratings’ international expertise and Agusto & Co.’s extensive Pan-African market experience. [e002:f02] Agusto & Co. currently operates in Nigeria, Kenya, Rwanda and Ghana. [e002:f03] According to the companies, the investment represents a strategic step that will complement the growth strategy of S&P Global Ratings in Africa by combining S&P Global’s global resources with Agusto & Co.’s established regional presence to expand market insights, enhance credit transparency and support market participants across the continent. [e002:f04] Commenting on the transaction, President of S&P Global Ratings, Yann Le Pallec, said the deal will foster informed analysis, constructive market dialogue, and greater investor confidence both regionally and internationally. [e002:f05] “We are delighted to partner with Agusto & Co. to strengthen our domestic ratings presence across Africa. [e002:f06] “Africa’s opportunity is extraordinary, and by combining our global expertise with Agusto & Co.’s deep local insights, together we can foster informed analysis, constructive market dialogue, and greater investor confidence both regionally and internationally,” the S&P chief executive stated. [e002:f07] For her part, the Managing Director of Agusto & Co., Yinka Adelekan, described the partnership as a landmark development for the company and Africa’s capital markets. [e002:f08] “This partnership is a transformational milestone for Agusto & Co. and African capital markets, fulfilling our late founder’s vision of affiliating with a leading global rating agency. [e002:f09] For more than 30 years, we have built a trusted credit rating institution across Africa. [e002:f10] Agusto & Co. is one of Africa’s foremost credit rating agencies, providing ratings for [financial](http:// institutions, corporates and other entities across the continent. [e002:f11] Since its establishment more than three decades ago, the firm has assigned over 4,000 ratings covering banks, insurance companies, [finance](http:// and leasing firms, mortgage institutions, investment managers, sovereigns, municipal bonds, corporate bonds and other debt instruments. [e002:f12] It is also an Approved Verifier under the Climate Bonds Standard for green bonds, projects and assets in Africa and is recognised by the International Capital Market Association (ICMA) as an External Reviewer providing Second Party Opinions on sustainable finance instruments. [e002:f13] Through S&P Global Ratings, the company assesses the creditworthiness of sovereigns, corporations, financial institutions and structured finance instruments across global markets, with its ratings widely used by investors, lenders and regulators in making investment and risk management decisions. [e002:f14] Following completion of the transaction, the statement stressed that Agusto & Co. will continue to operate as a separate ratings entity and will issue its own credit ratings and methodologies in line with applicable regulatory requirements. [e002:f15] However, the acquisition remains subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals. [e002:f16] S&P Global said the transaction is not expected to have a material impact on the financial results of either the company or S&P Global Ratings.
